timing: After catalogue availability and metadata inspection, before infrared candidate outcomes or matching-control results. Exploratory association validation, not preregistered astrophysics.
sample: All265 existing C3/X3 DES hosts with three-band usable SPIRE coverage; each relevant raw infrared catalogue separately.
statistics: Actual positional-match fraction, unique and ambiguous counts
Mean match fraction at36 nearby shifted positions
Physical-host bootstrap interval of actual-minus-shifted match fraction, conditional on these catalogues and shifts
scope: Empirical local association controls, not calibrated posterior false-match probabilities. Unknown catalogue footprint, detection selection, galaxy clustering and source blending remain. No flux selection or zero-flux imputation.
